title: Drawing: Saikyou Mangaka wa Oekaki Skill de Isekai Musou Suru!
titleRomaji: Drawing: Saikyou Mangaka wa Oekaki Skill de Isekai Musou Suru!
titleNative: ドローイング 最強漫画家はお絵かきスキルで異世界無双する！
synonyms: Drawing: The Greatest Mangaka Becomes A Skilled “Martial Artist” In Another World
synopsis: Akira Kamishiro was a very successful manga author, who was diagnosed with blood cancer one day. He regretted the way he lived, where he could only build up empty relationships. Angry at his mother for asking him to send her some money, he died in a car accident. He was given a chance to choose his new mother and reincarnate in another world. Akira, not wanting to have a repeat of his past life, decided to choose an ordinary but safe life.. He was reincarnated as Akira, the only son of a magic store, with his previous life's memories. He had no talent for swordsmanship or magic, but he didn't care as he was still loved by his family. At one point, he realized that he can embody various things by "drawing a picture". That's when he noticed his cheat ability...!? This is a story of Akira who wanted to live a mediocre life in another world and his adventures to protect his peaceful place!!

synonyms: The Legendary Wicked Woman Wants a Peaceful Second Life as a Boring Studious Girl
synopsis: "Don’t you think it’s stupid to be so madly in love?" Princess Letitia is due to be executed by guillotine, for the terrible crimes she committed trying to win back her fiancee's love. However, just when she thought she was dead, she was returned back in time for a second chance at life. "I won’t fall in love in my new life. I’m going to live peacefully by becoming a sober, hard-working student with glasses!” But one day, her glasses slip off and Camilo, the school's superstar, sees her true face. Then, for some reason, Camilo begins to dote on her in a tidal wave of affection…!? (Source: Comic Days, translated)

titleNative: 老後に備えて異世界で８万枚の金貨を貯めます
synonyms: เก็บเงินต่างโลก 8 หมื่นเหรียญไว้ใช้ยามเกษียณไงคะ
synopsis: After growing up an orphan, Mitsuha has a healthy respect for money and a desire to live well—at least, until she dies after being pushed off a cliff. Waking up in a strange fantasy world, Mitsuha narrowly survives an encounter with a pack of wolves, then realizes she has the power to move between this world and the real one. A lesser person might embark on heroic adventures—Mitsuha instead immediately recognizes the lucrative possibilities of her new situation, and heads out to buy an arsenal of modern weapons. Her goal: to acquire 80,000 gold, and the life of leisure she’s always dreamed of! (Source: Kodansha USA)

synopsis: Kitami, a boy serving as class representative, is struggling to get a girl named Toujou — who transferred into the class in the middle of the semester — to fit in better with the class. Kitami desperately tries to stand up for her, but he gradually becomes isolated... (Source: Gangan Online, translated)

title: Tantei Akechi wa Kyouran su
synopsis: The manga's story is an homage to Edogawa Rampo's fictional character Akechi Kogorou. The mystery centers around Mayumi Hanazaki, a middle-school girl who used to live with her aunt and uncle until a mysterious person mercilessly killed both. Now, thanks to an unusual incident, Mayumi relies upon the spirit of the legendary detective Kogorou Akechi to solve case. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Momo no Koto: Aiken to Roujin no Saigo no Hibi
titleRomaji: Momo no Koto: Aiken to Roujin no Saigo no Hibi
titleNative: もものこと　愛犬と老人の最期の日々
synopsis: Yuzo Karita is 81 years old. He lives on a meager pension. His only emotional support is his beloved dog, Momo. Karita is happy as long as he can be with Momo. One day, during a medical checkup, Karita is told that he has only one year left to live. With his remaining time, he desperately tries to find a foster home for Momo. What fate awaits Karita and Momo? This is a moving tale of an old man, his dog, and the deep bond between them that will touch the heart of anyone who reads it. (Source: Shogakukan, translated)
